newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares continue firmer but trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares continue firmer but trade quiet.

text.p: Zimbabwe's key industrial index added 4.32 points to close at 10,911.26 on Wednesdy but brokers expected the bourse to continue letting off steam after the bull-run of the past week.
"(Today was) a quieter day indicating a slowing down in the market. Institutions seem to be taking a slight back seat with the higher prices," one broker said.

Counters to advance on Wednesday included clothing retailer Truworths, up 70 cents to 720, while tobacco firm Rothmans added 250 cents to 4,350, and door and window maker Radar, bankers NMB and hoteliers Meikles were all up 50 cents to 500, 3,500 and 3,050 respectively.
Cool drink company Schweppes put on 30 cents to 400 while tea and coffee growers EHPL topped off the winners list with a 15-cent gain to 265.
Minings were also quiet and largely unchanged but gold giant Ashanti ZDRs shed five cents to 100 and the secondary index eased 4.05 points to 867.03.
